evals.prompt: Show me all my Grimmory libraries
evals.expected_output: Call grimmory_list_libraries tool and return list of libraries with names and IDs

evals.prompt: List all shelves in my main library
evals.expected_output: Ask for library ID or search for 'main' library, then call grimmory_list_shelves with libraryId

assertions.name: identifies_library_first
assertions.description: Should either ask for clarification or search for library

evals.prompt: What books are in my 'Favorites' shelf?
evals.expected_output: Find shelf ID for 'Favorites', then call grimmory_get_shelf_books

assertions.name: finds_shelf_then_books
assertions.description: Should find shelf ID before getting books

evals.prompt: Search for books by Isaac Asimov in my library
evals.expected_output: Call grimmory_list_books with search parameter 'Isaac Asimov'

assertions.name: uses_search_parameter
assertions.description: Should use search parameter in list_books call

assertions.name: calls_get_book
assertions.description: Should call grimmory_get_book with correct ID

evals.prompt: Show me the first 10 books in my Science Fiction library, sorted by title ascending
evals.expected_output: Find Science Fiction library ID, then call list_books with pagination (size: 10), sort: 'title', dir: 'asc'

assertions.name: uses_pagination_and_sorting
assertions.description: Should include pagination and sorting parameters
